title: ～ていく — “go on ～ing / from now on”
summary: Attach いく to the te-form to show an action or change continuing from now into the future, or moving away from the speaker: 勉強していく, 増えていく.

patterns.gloss: Verb te-form + いく (勉強していく)

body.p: これからも日本語を勉強していきます means you will continue from now on. It also marks change: 増えていく, 変わっていく.

body.h: ていく versus てくる
body.p: ていく is change from now toward the future; てくる is change from the past up to now (寒くなってきた). Learn them as a pair.

examples.ja: これからも日本語（にほんご）を勉強（べんきょう）していきます。
examples.romaji: Kore kara mo Nihongo o benkyō shite ikimasu.
examples.tr: I will keep studying Japanese from now on.

examples.ja: これから毎朝（まいあさ）早（はや）く起（お）きていくつもりです。
examples.romaji: Korekara maiasa hayaku okite iku tsumori desu.
examples.tr: From now on I plan to keep getting up early every morning.

examples.ja: この町（まち）の人口（じんこう）はこれからも増（ふ）えていくでしょう。
examples.romaji: Kono machi no jinkō wa korekara mo fuete iku deshō.
examples.tr: This town's population will probably keep increasing from now on.

pitfalls: For change from the past up to now, use てくる.
As an auxiliary it is usually written in kana: いく.
